Printed labels in order: "First symptoms - October 2015" (above), "Positive C-ANCA and a nasal mucosa biopsy → granulomatois with polyangiitis diagnosis November 2015" (below), "Symptoms worse - February 2016" (above), "Hospital admission - March 2016" (below), "Seizure and total atrioventricular block" (above), "Transvenous pacemaker + definitive pacemaker six days later" (below), "Rituximab" (above) and "Still receiving rituximab. Clinically well with a normalization of all of the disease activity markers. Sinous rhythm. Pacemaker turned of and waiting for withdrawal" (below).
